structure.title: A presence in four strategic locations.
structure.body: CNRC has a network of strategically distributed offices that lets us act with proximity, speed and efficiency:

resources.titleLine1: The only firm in the country with
resources.p1: CNRC is the only credit recovery firm in mainland Portugal and its islands, as well as the entire Schengen area, with all human and material resources owned in-house, ensuring complete operational autonomy and execution capacity.
resources.means1: Fleet of heavy and light transport vehicles
resources.means2: Mobile workshop equipped for lock removal and replacement, vehicle unblocking and removal, and secure transport of seized goods
resources.means3: Warehouses for storing goods pending judicial decision
resources.means4: In-house helicopter, enabling urgent travel and immediate response whenever there is a risk of asset concealment

legal.title: Mandate, security, legality.
legal.p1: All CNRC procedures are carried out under mandate and accompanied by security forces, ensuring strict compliance with the law and the safety of all parties involved.
legal.partner1: Enforcement Agents, ensuring fast scheduling and execution of procedures.
legal.p2: Clients may also use their own lawyers, subsequently sending us the documents needed for CNRC to act.

differentiation.title: Compliance within 4 days of the court order.
differentiation.p1: CNRC stands out for its ability to enforce judicial decisions within a maximum of 4 days following a court order in precautionary procedures or summary enforcement actions.
differentiation.p2: Our track record since {founded} is extremely positive, with continuous growth in demand and recognition from public bodies, including the Public Prosecutor's Office.

mission.title: The future belongs to specialised firms.
mission.body: We believe the future of credit recovery belongs to specialised firms like CNRC, contributing to:
mission.item3: Greater efficiency in enforcing judicial decisions

equipa.metaDescription: Meet the multidisciplinary team at Camacho & Nunes Recuperação de Crédito: lawyers, solicitors, operational staff and expert assessors.

hero.title: Our success rests on competence.
hero.p1: A multidisciplinary team of highly qualified professionals, used to operating in sensitive contexts with high responsibility.
hero.p2: Each member contributes experience, precision and an ethical mindset, ensuring every case is handled with attention to detail, responsibility and respect for what matters most to you.

ceo.p1: CNRC's leadership is defined by high standards and a commitment to excellence. {ceo} personally oversees every case, ensuring the highest levels of rigour and professional ethics.
ceo.p2: With a clear vision for the future of credit recovery in Portugal and across the Schengen area, he leads a team capable of meeting any challenge with speed and effectiveness.

pillars.title: Three pillars supporting every result.
pillars.p1Desc: Lawyers and solicitors with extensive experience in civil procedural law, insolvency and enforcement.
pillars.p2Desc: Field teams trained in controlled access techniques, animal handling, crane operation and helicopter piloting.
pillars.p3Desc: Expert assessors, case managers and a reporting team that ensure full traceability of every procedure.

hero.title: Six strategic locations.
hero.subtitle: Our network covers mainland Portugal, the islands and Southern Spain, ensuring a rapid response to any operation in the Schengen area.

instalacoes.metaDescription: CNRC's complex in Pinhal Novo: heliport, seized-goods warehouse, kennels for live animals and vehicle yard.

hero.title: Facilities designed for operational excellence.
hero.p1: Our facilities in Pinhal Novo were designed to provide every condition needed for the full operation of Camacho & Nunes's resources. We have spacious, modern, fully equipped premises ready to meet the demands of autonomy, efficiency and technical complexity of our equipment and teams.
hero.p2: Our infrastructure reflects Camacho & Nunes's commitment to quality, compliance and operational excellence.

heliport.body: A certified structure for regular operation of CNRC's in-house helicopter, with maintenance and refuelling areas. It allows urgent travel and immediate response whenever there is a risk of asset concealment.

kennels.title: Certified care for every seized species.
kennels.body: In addition to areas dedicated to operations, we have specific facilities for the storage and custody of seized animals. These spaces guarantee all conditions for housing, safety and welfare, in strict compliance with applicable legislation.

complementary.title: Everything that's needed, under one roof.
complementary.warehouseBody: A secure, video-monitored facility with access control, for storing seized movable goods pending judicial decision. Capacity for vehicles, industrial equipment and other large-scale items.
complementary.fleetBody: Complete in-house fleet: special forced-entry vehicles, trailers, cranes, forklifts and mobile kitchen. All resources are owned, ensuring complete operational autonomy with no dependence on third parties.

areas.metaDescription: Enforcement, Seizures, Insolvency, Forced Entry, Specific Performance, Judicial Expertise and Real Estate. Rigour, speed and total operational autonomy.

executions.title: Enforcement
executions.p1: We provide specialised support enforcing judicial decisions, ensuring that rights recognised by the courts are effectively upheld. We act swiftly, rigorously and in full legal compliance, ensuring practical fulfilment of the obligations imposed on the debtor.
executions.p2: Our team has every operational resource needed, including fully equipped vehicles, appropriate tools and experienced professionals, ready to act in simple or highly complex contexts.
executions.p3: Our services stand out for their ability to effectively enforce judicial measures, whether seizing assets, delivering specific items or implementing other enforcement orders. We work closely with enforcement agents, courts and other entities, ensuring swift and legally impeccable proceedings.

seizures.title: Seizures
seizures.p1: We carry out seizures ordered by judicial authority, ensuring the quick and secure attachment of assets whenever required to guarantee compliance with decisions or to safeguard credits. We act with total legal rigour, efficient coordination and absolute respect for the required procedures.
seizures.p2: Our team has every operational resource — fully equipped vehicles, appropriate tools and experienced professionals — ready to act in simple or highly complex contexts. Each intervention is conducted with precision, discretion and a focus on protecting assets and the effectiveness of the procedure.

insolvency.title: Insolvency
insolvency.p1: We support companies and individuals in insolvency proceedings with a rigorous, strategic and results-driven approach. We work to ensure every case proceeds in full legal compliance, protecting the interests involved with maximum efficiency in managing assets and liabilities.
insolvency.b1: Full follow-up of judicially declared insolvency proceedings
insolvency.b2: Inventory, seizure and management of the debtor's assets
insolvency.b3: Support preparing and executing insolvency or recovery plans
insolvency.b4: Coordination with judicial administrators, courts and other entities
insolvency.b5: Rapid action in urgent or highly complex contexts

breakIns.title: Forced Entry
breakIns.p1: We carry out forced entries as part of judicial procedures in full legal compliance, ensuring safe and controlled access to properties whenever ordered by the competent authority. Our approach combines speed, precision and absolute respect for judicial procedures.
breakIns.p2: We have highly trained operational teams and vehicles fully equipped for this type of action, allowing us to respond effectively to urgent or complex situations.

factProvision.title: Specific Performance
factProvision.p1: Our team provides highly specialised Specific Performance services, ensuring the effective fulfilment of obligations that do not involve a monetary payment but rather the performance, abstention or delivery of a specific item. We act with legal rigour, procedural speed and a focus on the practical realisation of our clients' rights.
factProvision.p2: Our experience is reflected in successful cases where we ensured full enforcement of judicial decisions, even in complex situations or where there was resistance to compliance.

expertise.title: Judicial Expertise
expertise.p1: We act with technical rigour, impartiality and a total commitment to the truth of the facts. Our Judicial Expertise services support judicial, administrative and private proceedings, providing specialised analyses and complete, well-founded, high-quality expert reports.
expertise.bulletsHeading: Our preparation of expert reports rests on
expertise.b1: Photo Certification — technical and documentary validation of images, ensuring authenticity, integrity and legal compliance
expertise.b2: Photographic Report — rigorous visual record of sites, goods, damage or relevant events, with technical description and objective analysis
expertise.b3: Incident Report — technical investigation, evidence gathering and factual analysis to clarify events and support decisions
expertise.b4: Property Valuation — recognised methodologies, market analysis, legal framing and well-founded determination of real value

realEstate.title: Real Estate
realEstate.p1: Our firm focuses on managing and developing investments with strong growth potential, acting with rigour, transparency and strategic vision. Over the years we have built a solid portfolio of carefully selected assets with a consistent track record of appreciation.
realEstate.p2: Our portfolio currently includes several investments that have appreciated significantly, the result of a strategy focused on asset quality, innovation and anticipating trends.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: The entity responsible for processing personal data is {legalName}, with registered office at {street}, {postal} {city}, NIF {nif}. Contact: {email} · {phone}.
privacy.p2: We collect only the data strictly necessary to provide our services: identification and contact data, case data (in judicial procedures) and technical navigation data on this site.
privacy.li3a: Provision of credit recovery services and judicial procedures.
privacy.li3b: Responding to requests made through contact forms.
privacy.li3c: Fulfilment of legal and regulatory obligations.
privacy.li3d: Continuous improvement of the site's browsing experience, subject to prior consent.
privacy.p4: Processing is based, depending on the case, on the data subject's consent, performance of a contract, fulfilment of a legal obligation or the legitimate interest of the data controller.
privacy.p5: Personal data is retained only for the period strictly necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, always respecting applicable legal periods, namely in tax and procedural matters.
privacy.p6: Data may be shared with judicial authorities, enforcement agents, police forces and other entities legally required within the scope of the contracted procedures. We do not transfer data to third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.p7: Under the GDPR, you may exercise at any time the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. Simply contact us at {email}.
privacy.p8: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the National Data Protection Commission (CNPD), the competent supervisory authority in Portugal.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the site to recognise you, remember preferences and produce usage statistics.
cookies.p2a: Essential for the basic operation of the site, namely navigation and the use of features such as forms. These cannot be disabled.
cookies.p2b: Allow user choices to be remembered to personalise the browsing experience (for example, language or location).
cookies.p2c: Collect aggregated and anonymous information about site use, helping us improve content and the experience. Only activated with consent.
cookies.p2d: Used to present relevant institutional content on third-party platforms. Only activated with express consent.
cookies.p3: You can change your preferences at any time through the consent banner shown on your first visit. Your choice is stored locally and respected on subsequent visits.
cookies.p4: Some cookies may be set by external services (e.g., analytics platforms). These services process data according to their own privacy policies, always in compliance with the GDPR.
cookies.p5: For further clarification, please contact us through the channels listed in our Privacy Policy.
